title: Rain on the glass, city out of focus

tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph filling the entire frame edge to edge with no border, frame, letterbox band or matte of any kind. Read the soft-radius anodised case named first as this phone: one solid slab upright at half frame height, its matte frosted charcoal back to camera - one continuous sheet from top edge to bottom, crossed by no seam, no second panel, no line anywhere, the display face turned entirely away and never visible. High on it, one horizontal machined plateau carries exactly three lens rings and one flash. Turned a few degrees, one flat brushed-titanium rail shows as a narrow band down the near side, carrying one power button and one volume rocker; the far edge stays bare. Eleven at night, from the warm side of the window. 85mm at f/1.8 level with the plateau, the beaded pane a hand's width from the lens: four fat beads sit on the glass right across the phone's back, thrown soft while it stays sharp, one drop running a tapering trail. A single unbroken cold cyan line rims the near rail; the frosted back drinks it and stays matte. The pane runs to all four edges. Unmarked.
